t: You're looking at St Lawrence Jewry, a Church of England guild church on Gresham Street, right beside the Guildhall. It's the official church of the Lord Mayor of London. The Great Fire of 1666 destroyed it, and it was rebuilt to the designs of Sir Christopher Wren, who was given responsibility for rebuilding fifty-two City churches. Several notable people are buried here. John Wilkins was a founder of the Royal Society and Bishop of Chester, and John Tillotson was Archbishop of Canterbury. The physician George Ent is here too, and so is the alderman Henry Cornish, who was executed under James the Second.
